headline: Melides MG House / Pereira Miguel Arquitectos
context: Located in Esteveira, Melides , this project is a single-family house consisting of several volumes and a swimming pool, all interconnected though outdoor spaces that form an angle, following the natural amphitheatre contours of the site.
